```yaml
id: analysis-v1

container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```
